domain_order.description: a domain a space bought at checkout, held in the platform's registrar account; domain_registered{at, expires} once the registry holds it, domain_refused{at, why} where it could not be registered, and domain_refunded{at, refund} once its payment is returned

space.description: the space currently responsible for renewal

bought_by.description: the space that paid for the first year, recorded when renewal first moves to another space

serves.description: the checkout’s initial destination on older orders, if chosen

checkout.description: the paid checkout, which names the order however often its payment is told

cents.description: what the person paid, in cents: the registry's price for the first year

renews.description: the registrar’s yearly renewal quote at checkout, in cents

renewalTerms.description: the owner bought the domain under the capped renewal terms

live.description: whether its payment moved money; a sandbox payment's order registers nothing and is refunded

domain_registered.description: a bought domain the registry holds, with its DNS written, and when its year ends

domain_refused.description: a bought domain that could not be registered, and why: a sandbox payment, a name another checkout bought first, or the registry's refusal; its payment is owed back until domain_refunded

domain_refunded.description: a refused domain order whose payment was returned whole, and the payment provider's refund

register_domain.description: register a bought domain at the registry, waiting out its workflow, then prepare its hostname and write its DNS records; refund one that cannot be registered

renew_domains.description: Reconcile the annual renewals of the domains a space holds

renew_transferred_domain.description: Reconcile a transferred domain and the included-domain choices in both spaces

domain_choice.description: the order a space chooses for its domain renewal allowance

domain_credit_used.description: The renewal through which a space last spent its annual domain credit

domain_renewal.description: the current annual renewal of a bought domain with its quoted registrar price in cents and its paid checkout, once paid

domain_renewal_paid.description: A checkout that paid for one renewal of a registered domain

domain_courtesy.description: the last renewal covered under the former plan terms, for the space that held the order when the terms changed

renew_domain_order.description: Reconcile a new registration or a paid domain renewal

domain_renewals_due.description: Refresh the price, payment and registrar settings for annual domain renewals
